news_cards.title: Bihar Mein 51600 Karod Rupye Ka Nivesh Hoga, Steel Hub Banega
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne kaha ki desh ke pramukh udyogik samuhon ke saath MoU par hastakshar kiye gaye hain, jisse Bihar mein 51600 karod rupye ka nivesh hoga
Is nivesh se Bihar steel hub ban jayega, jisse hazaron logon ko rozgar milega, aur rajya ki arthvyavastha ko bhi badhava milega
Yeh nivesh Bihar Investment Promotion Policy ke tahat aayega, jiska uddeshya rajya mein udyogon ko badhava dena aur nivesh ko akarshit karna hai

news_cards.title: Gaya Mein 6 Hazar Karod Rupye Ki Ekikrit Ispat Pariyonjana
bullets: Mukhyamantri ke samaksh Gaya mein 6 hazar karod rupye ki ekikrit ispat pariyojana ke liye MoU par hastakshar kiye gaye hain
Is pariyojana se Gaya mein ispat udyog ko badhava milega, aur rajya ki arthvyavastha ko bhi badhava milega
Yeh pariyojana Saat Nischay-2 ke tahat aayegi, jiska uddeshya rajya mein udyogon ko badhava dena aur nivesh ko akarshit karna hai

news_cards.title: JP Ganga Path Ko Milega Vishwashtariya Swaroop
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne JP Ganga Path ko vishwashtariya swaroop dena shuru kiya hai, jisse rajya mein parivahan ko badhava milega
Is pariyojana se 65 kilometer Ganga channel viksit kiya jayega, jisse rajya ki jal parivahan vyavastha ko badhava milega
Yeh pariyojana Bihar Investment Promotion Policy ke tahat aayegi, jiska uddeshya rajya mein parivahan ko badhava dena aur nivesh ko akarshit karna hai

news_cards.title: Nasariganj-Panapur Nishulk Steamer Ferry Seva Ka Shubharambh
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne Nasariganj-Panapur nishulk steamer ferry seva ka shubharambh kiya hai, jisse rajya mein parivahan ko badhava milega
Is seva se logon ko nishulk parivahan suvidha milegi, aur rajya ki arthvyavastha ko bhi badhava milega
Yeh seva Bihar Investment Promotion Policy ke tahat aayegi, jiska uddeshya rajya mein parivahan ko badhava dena aur nivesh ko akarshit karna hai

news_cards.title: Bihar Mein Nishamukt Yuva Abhiyan
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne Bihar mein nishamukt yuva abhiyan ka shubharambh kiya hai, jisse rajya mein yuvaon ko nishamukt banana hai
Is abhiyan se yuvaon ko nishamukt banana hai, aur unhein samajik aur arthik roop se samarth banaya jayega
Yeh abhiyan Saat Nischay-2 ke tahat aayega, jiska uddeshya rajya mein yuvaon ko nishamukt banana hai
